steps.text: Hi, I’m Little Suansuan, let me introduce the Lab for Affective and Cognitive Intelligent Robotics.

Our core mission is to empower robots with true intelligence, cognition, and emotional abilities. We want robots to understand humans, possess emotional intelligence, perform tasks effectively, and communicate naturally.
We focus on affective and cognitive models: observe human cues, infer emotions and intentions, and let robots respond appropriately.
We have built three prototypes to run our models: AISR, Big Suansuan, and me — Little Suansuan.
We have published over 80 high-quality papers, secured 24 patents, and our work has been featured by many media. We also have wide industry adoption.
This is our actual workspace where we learn, research, and experiment. Welcome to experience our daily work!
